explication: bitchat is a decentralized messaging app whose principal workflow is: a user composes a message, the chat view model routes it over Bluetooth mesh when possible, falls back to Nostr relays when needed, and delivers received content back into conversations. Location channels, private encryption, peer discovery, synchronization, commands, media, and voice are separate stages around that flow. The graph emphasizes documented routing and sampled orchestration; several lower-level BLE policies and persistence details are consolidated rather than enumerated.
